text:
QUOTE: "Engine → caller (`char*` returns, e.g. `entropic_run`'s `result_json`) | Caller owns it; free with `entropic_free()`." and "`const char*` returns | Owned by the handle; valid only until the next call on that handle. Do not free."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both halves: returned `char*` is caller-owned and freed with `entropic_free`, and `const char*` is handle-owned and valid only until the next call.
